messages:
Lena (Product): Hey team — quick design review thread for the compact annotation UI and approval ordering in eval runs. Pasting the Figma and a few questions. https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/compact-annotations Anya (Design): Thanks! main concerns: visual weight of approved vs pending rows, and where bulk-approve sits when multi-select is on mobile. right now the CTA floats over content which feels noisy. :thinking_face: Mike (Eng): re: performance, multi-select on 2k rows could be expensive if we do client-side diffs + selection states. can we lazy-render? also can we avoid keeping full token diffs in DOM? Anya (Design): We can virtualize the list. For the compact diff we only render diff summary rows until expand. mobile design shows checkboxes in the left gutter, but they collapse on very small widths. Priya (Accessibility): A11y nit: approve/unapprove buttons need semantic roles and predictable focus order. when bulk panel opens focus should move to first actionable and return to triggering control on close. also color contrast of the green badge is borderline on low-light themes. Sam (DevEx): Keyboard flows request: support shift+arrow for range select, and a single key shortcut (A) to approve selected. we should expose in keyboard shortcuts modal. Also mention undo stack (Ctrl+Z) for bulk ops? Jordan (PM): Copy question — current CTA says "Approve 12" when 12 selected. ambiguous whether it's approving 12 items or confirming. maybe "Approve selected (12)" or just "Approve selected" with count next to badge. Thoughts? Anya (Design): I prefer "Approve selected (12)" — clearer. Also thinking about placing contextual help icon next to bulk actions explaining what approval means (e.g. moves tests to "approved" and locks prompts). Mike (Eng): Technically fine. We should make the API call idempotent and show per-item progress in the list (spinner per-row) to avoid confusing partial failures. For scale, we chunk by 50 and show toast summary for failures. Lena (Product): Good call. Let's make UX show per-row state and a summary toast. Add rollback CTA in toast: "Undo approvals". Priya (Accessibility): Also ensure toast is announced via live region and that the undo button is focusable by keyboard. aria-live="polite" and role="status" should work. Example snippet: ```html
Approved 12 tests.
``` Sam (DevEx): Nice. For onboarding, add a microcopy line in the approval flow: "Approvals can be undone within 5 minutes" and link to audit log in the docs. Anya (Design): Layout question: when scorecard is open as a side panel, should compact diffs collapse horizontally or remain scrollable inside panel? Collapsing saves vertical space but may hide key info. :eyes: Mike (Eng): Keep them scrollable inside panel. Collapsing will complicate keyboard focus management and cause layout shifts. Priya (Accessibility): If we keep scrollable, ensure keyboard-only users can reach per-diff controls without complex tabbing (use roving tabindex pattern). Jordan (PM): Prioritization: Can we ship the copy + toast + keyboard undo within 2 sprints and defer virtualization to a follow-up? Lena (Product): Yes — priority A: copy + toast + aria fixes + undo. Priority B: virtualization and chunking improvements. I'll update the ticket. deploy-bot: New mock uploaded (compact-annotations/v3) by Anya. Screenshot attached. Mike (Eng): Quick follow-up on testing: add an e2e that simulates bulk approve with partial failures to ensure undo and per-row states behave. Sam (DevEx): I'll add the keyboard shortcut docs and the shortcuts modal entry. Also will draft the microcopy for the undo window. Anya (Design): I'll push small a11y adjustments and alternate color variants for dark mode. Lena (Product): Thanks everyone — I’ll file the PRD changes and spin up the rollout plan (canary + feature flag). :sparkles:
